title: Saved Recipient Allowances of the Personal Sender Account Levels
content:
The book of saved recipients on a Personal Sender Account is sized by the account's verification level. Three figures apply at each level: how many active saved recipients the account may hold, how many recipients may be added within a rolling 30-calendar-day period, and for how many hours after a recipient is added a first transfer to that recipient is held for screening before release.

| Level | Active saved recipients (most) | Recipients added in rolling 30 calendar days (most) | Screening hold on a first transfer to a new recipient (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 5 | 2 | 24 |
| Paloma Verified | 15 | 5 | 4 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 30 | 8 | 0 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 50 | 12 | 0 |
| Paloma Premier | 75 | 20 | 0 |
| Paloma Private Client | 150 | 40 | 0 |

A screening hold of 0 hours means there is no such hold at that level.

## Points of reading

- The first column counts saved recipients whose recipient status is active; the second counts recipients added, whatever has happened to them since.
- Only Paloma Starter and Paloma Verified carry a screening hold on a first transfer to a newly added recipient: 24 hours and 4 hours respectively.
- Hypothetical comparison: an account at Paloma Verified may hold up to 15 active saved recipients and add up to 5 within 30 calendar days, while an account at Paloma Enhanced may hold up to 50 and add up to 12. The two levels are chosen only to show how the table is read.
